title: Reprogramming efficiency of human embryonic fibroblasts using polycistronic lentiviral expression of reprogramming factors OSKM. Testing of factors that enhance efficiency
protocol: Plate 293T cells into 10 cm dishes in a final volume of 9 ml MEF medium per dish.
Transfect the 293T cells from day 1 with Fugene 6.
Incubate tube 1 containing Optimem and Fugene 6 for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate tube 2 containing LV-OSKM or LV-gene of interest, psPAX2, pCMV-VSVG, and Optimem for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Mix tubes 1 and 2 gently by flicking after incubation.
Incubate the mixed solution for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Add 200 μl of the mixture per 10 cm dish.
Shake and incubate for 72 hours.
Plate F134 human embryonic fibroblasts at 100,000 cells per well in a 6 wells plate in MEF medium.
Collect supernatant of dishes with transfected 293T cells and filter through 0.45 μm PVDF filters.
Spin filtered supernatant by ultra-centrifugation at 20 krpm in an SW32Ti rotor for 2 hr at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant by decanting.
Dissolve the pellet into 1000 μl DMEM low glucose.
Use the virus directly to infect cells or store virus for less than 1 week at 4 °C or in aliquots at -80 °C.
Infect the plated F134 cells from Day 4 with 50 μl of concentrated OSKM virus and 50 μl of the concentrated virus expressing the gene of interest.
Add 6 µg/ml protamine sulfate directly into the medium and mix by swirling.
Replace medium of infected F134 cells by washing three times with PBS followed by MEF medium.
Plate CF-1 MEF feeder cells with 1,7 x 10e4 cells per cm2 into a gelatinized 6 wells plate.
Trypsinize infected F134 cells on day 11.
Plate 10,000 trypsinized cells per well onto feeders plated on day 11.
Change medium to iPS medium.
Daily refresh the medium with iPS medium from day 12 onwards.
Count colonies with iPS-like morphology or process for Tra1-60 colony staining or single cell FACS analysis on day 29.
